methods.Population: Common eligible participants across all five methods per group/sex/age panel
methods.Raw_CentileBrain_BAG: CentileBrain predicted brain age - chronological age; no adjustment
methods.CentileBrain_Panel_Adjustment: Supplied Adjusted_BrainAGE, with CentileBrain's separate sex-by-age-panel linear adjustment
methods.Training_Bucket_Adjustment: Raw CentileBrain BAG - (sex/panel training-bin slope * chronological_age + intercept)
methods.Formula: Training-reference W-year bucket-adjusted BAG = raw CentileBrain BAG - fitted training raw-BAG trend within the W-year bin
methods.BrainAGE_S: CentileBrain panel-adjusted BAG - own eligible cohort slope * (age - own eligible cohort mean age)
methods.Extrapolation: Apply the fitted regression within its bin; flag ages outside training observed support
methods.Unfit_Bin: Leave correction unavailable; retain participant and reason
methods.Inference: Descriptive gaps; model training independence and upstream MRI inference are unverified
